options.pitch: Epic Games used AI to convert more than 20,000 of Fortnite's Blueprints into about 3 million lines of Verse, and on that basis Unreal Engine 6 will ship without Blueprints. Epic is retiring the visual tool millions of game makers learned on because an AI could translate its biggest game out of it, so any game studio or creator on Unreal knows the skill they built is being replaced by code an AI wrote.

Maxon, the software company behind Cinema 4D and ZBrush, now sells AI model generation inside its apps, run on other firms' models such as Tripo and Rodin and billed in credits. 3D artists using Cinema 4D and ZBrush now get AI model generation inside their apps, but the models come from other firms and the credits expire monthly, so any studio budgeting for it knows what it is actually paying for.
